rationale: Continued mixed-acid fermentation of glucose with arginine and ammonium co-utilization. Glucose supports primary ATP and reducing power; arginine provides supplemental C and essential N. Acetate and lactate are major fermentation products. Growth rate 0.40 /h is sustainable by available N (3.5 mmol N in vs 3.2 mmol cost) and C balance (60.3 in vs 12 growth + 48.3 products).
